blockers.statement: The accepted prefix and product path still cover only exact contiguous float32 vecadd. Broadcast, cast, reduction, softmax, norm, GEMM, RoPE, cache, GDN, attention, SiluAndMul, full-model execution, multi-token inference, TP, and CCL remain unproven and must not be inferred from CP-0029.

changes: Applied only the self-amdgpu-runtime tests/queue_test.c ordering fix and committed it as f9ef490668eb6b18bd72805cab2d2cb9140a6782.
Proved 100 serial and 1,800 concurrent queue mock runs with zero failures or timeouts, plus fresh GCC and Clang runtime matrices with all required tests passing.

Built and accepted a fresh schema-8 repository-local prefix with setup exit 0 under -j24, independent verify-only, installed and ordinary-cc OpenCL, ordinary Triton dual-launch, exact HSACO provenance, pollution, and active-isolation gates.
Preserved schema-6, schema-7, and parent-Git schema-8 attempts as NON-PASSING evidence and kept their failure classifications out of installation authority.
limitations: The accepted repository-local prefix remains bound to schema 8, setup script SHA d693191f1bc69ac84b64b4ad0a0e007c53bc796f6eefdf77e24769bd1980a360, the pinned source identities, and the exact 5,384-byte pure-b010 add_kernel image with SHA-256 7308427e69dea6f320178c55863291d4d615338eb295a422a5ff7a2c2b8afa95.

The accepted product boundary is contiguous float32 Triton vecadd at 98,432 elements with BLOCK_SIZE 1024, 97 programs, and two same-process launches; no second operator, model, multi-token inference, TP, CCL, profiling, or performance claim is made.

The CP-0029 setup was already in flight before the later ccache policy request. Subsequent LLVM/Triton project builds must use ccache plus clang/lld and -j24, reuse compatible completed build directories and caches, and clean only proven-obsolete directories; this accepted prefix is not retrofitted.

The parent-VCS schema-8 attempt is retained as NON-PASSING evidence. LLVM_APPEND_VC_REV=OFF, empty force VCS cache keys, undef-only VCS headers, and exact HSACO admission are required provenance gates.
The operator manifest remains a source contract only. Sampling, the full Qwen3.5 text path, stable multi-token decode, TP, and CCL remain unproven.

argv: Implement and validate the minimum Qwen3.5 BF16 SiluAndMul operator contract through the normal Triton simulator path
next_action.expected: CP-0030 will compile and execute the model-required BF16 SiluAndMul decode shape [1,7168] -> [1,3584] and masked-prefill shape [7,7168] -> [7,3584] through the normal Triton/runtime/gem5 path with exact image admission, differential oracle, trace evidence, deterministic repeats, and zero fallback. It will not claim the full operator matrix or model.
prerequisites: CP-0029, EV-0066, EV-0067, and BL-0108 are accepted and scripts/resume.sh --verify passes offline.
The schema-8 prefix remains the accepted repository-local toolchain/runtime authority and its manifest, setup stamp, and exact add_kernel artifact remain unchanged.
The Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B text-only contract is pinned at model revision 2fc06364715b967f1860aea9cf38778875588b17; the first operator gate is BF16 SiluAndMul, not sampling or full-model execution.
Any LLVM/Triton project build uses ccache, /usr/bin/clang, /usr/bin/ld.lld, and -j24, reuses compatible build directories/cache, and preserves accepted and NON-PASSING evidence.
next_action.rollback_boundary: Keep CP-0029 accepted with the exact float32 vecadd and schema-8 install authority. If the SiluAndMul image, ABI, oracle, trace, or no-fallback gate cannot be proven, do not weaken the existing vecadd admission or claim any broader operator, model, multi-token, TP, or CCL capability.
